description: Figure 1, titled "Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob," is a bar chart that visually compares the overall accuracy of three sentiment analysis algorithms: VADER, TextBlob, and ChatGPT. The horizontal axis lists the three algorithms as categorical labels, while the vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy," is scaled from 0.4 to 1.0 in increments of 0.1. The chart displays three vertical bars, each corresponding to one algorithm. The bar for VADER is a solid white rectangle, reaching an approximate accuracy of 0.7. The bar for TextBlob is a white rectangle with diagonal black stripes, reaching an approximate accuracy of 0.68. The bar for ChatGPT is a solid green rectangle, which is the tallest, reaching an approximate accuracy of 0.92. A legend to the right of the bars identifies the visual representation for each algorithm: a white square for VADER, a diagonally striped square for TextBlob, and a green square for ChatGPT. The chart is titled "Evaluation of ChatGPT VS various algorithms" below the x-axis.
